summary: @nebula.js/cli-sense preinstall hook drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers), detects platform/arch/musl, downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, unzips it, chmods it +x, and uses it to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-only obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array via WV8StW push/shift shuffle, numeric-literal table, string decoder hc1jfK9) shipped at the tarball root. The upstream Qlik `qlik-oss/nebula.js` project does not distribute setup.mjs or math_init.js; the library files (lib/api-entry.js, lib/build.js, lib/sense.js) appear genuine and serve as cover. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated bundle unrelated to the package's advertised Qlik Sense extension builder functionality is an alternate-runtime dropper that runs attacker-controlled code on every `npm install`. Use of Bun bypasses scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code paths.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
